title: Example 22-2: Bibliography with Long Dash

illustrates.quote: If two or more works by the same author are listed, a long print dash frequently is substituted for the author’s name. Use the long dash, spaced as shown in print, to reflect this type of print dash accurately. Follow print if other symbols are used.

blocks.text: Johns, Evan. 1965. An Industrial History of Ontario. Toronto: Fieldhouse Press.

blocks.features: Hanging indent. Begins with a long print dash in place of the author's name (spaced as in print).

print.notes: Print original is the picture in the example box (gold-22-A/page-598.png).
